question: ‘As I Lay Dying’ is an English novel by which of the following authors ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**William Faulkner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• William Faulkner's "As I Lay Dying" is recognized for its use of the stream of consciousness technique, whereby the narrative presents the subjective thoughts and feelings flowing through the minds of the characters.
 
• This novel employs 15 distinct narrators who relate their interior thoughts and emotions, ranging from deeply introspective musings to fragmented and almost incoherent internal dialogues.
 
• Faulkner's innovative narrative style in this novel, utilizing the stream of consciousness approach, gives the reader direct access to the characters’ inner experiences amidst the common action, lending the narrative its compelling depth and complexity.
